district_name: Mount Anthony Union High School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. Appendix ch. 5, section 5-12 validates the organization of Mt. Anthony Union High School District (No. 14); section 5-11 carries the Bennington at-large quirk (four Bennington directors elected at large). The district is a union high school district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union; its modern electorate is the Southwest Vermont Union Elementary SD plus the North Bennington Graded SD.

board.org_name: Mount Anthony Union High School Board

sources.note: Mount Anthony Union HSD No. 14: eleven directors, residency allocated Bennington 4 / North Bennington 2 / Pownal 2 / Shaftsbury 2 / Woodford 1 (FY22 directory), elected by all district voters by Australian ballot (modified at-large). Only the three members whose published terms (2027) run past the March 2026 election are minted. HELD: the three members whose terms expired 2026 (McEnaney, Aiken, Fredrickson -- the March 3, 2026 return is the missing document), the three whose terms expired at the March 4, 2025 election (Johnson, Sekora, Wallace -- re-election/succession undocumented), and the two unexpired-term seats filled March 4, 2025 (winners unnamed in any fetched document; missing: the March 4, 2025 annual meeting minutes / election return and the annual report for the March 3, 2026 meeting). SVSU/North Bennington/MAU Annual Report for the March 2025 annual meeting (official): the MAUHSD directory lists nine directors with term expirations -- Mulligan (Chair) 2027, McEnaney (Vice-Chair) 2026, Aiken (Clerk) 2026, Fredrickson 2026, Johnson 2025, Sekora 2025, Thurber 2027, Olmstead 2027, Wallace 2025 -- for an 11-seat board (SVSU FY22 Annual Report: "The MAUHS Board is comprised of 11 Directors who each serve 3 year terms"). The March 4, 2025 warning (Art. B, same report) elects five seats by Australian ballot from all district voters, including two unexpired-term seats (a NBGSD seat to 2026; a Pownal seat to 2027) -- i.e., two seats stood vacant at that election.
